visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a round scallion pancake being fried in a white pan with a wooden handle on a modern white induction cooktop. The lighting is bright and clean, typical of a well-lit kitchen. A pair of metal chopsticks flips the pancake to reveal a golden-brown, crispy surface. (2) The scene shifts to a white countertop where a hand with manicured nails places a small stainless steel measuring cup. Behind it, a wire egg basket holds several brown eggs. (3) The character cracks an egg into the small metal cup, showing the yolk and white clearly. (4) Back at the stove, the cooked pancake is lifted, and the egg mixture is poured into the pan, then the pancake is pressed onto it. (5) The camera moves to a white air fryer or oven rack where several marinated pork chops are being cooked. The character uses thin metal tongs to flip the meat. (6) In the kitchen, the character pours oil from a white dispenser into the pan. (7) The character uses large kitchen scissors to cut the cooked pork chops into strips on a piece of aluminum foil. (8) On a grey cutting board, the pancake with the egg is laid out, and the pork strips are placed on top. The character sprinkles seasoning from a white container. (9) The character rolls the pancake into a wrap and slides it into a decorated yellow greaseproof paper bag. (10) The final scene shows a black thermos under a water dispenser. Instant coffee powder is poured from a black packet into the thermos, and it is then shaken.
